programs.title: History's Greatest Escapes With Morgan Freeman
programs.desc: Rene Belbenoit, a petty thief, is captured and sent to France's notorious penal colony in French Guiana. He determines to escape or die trying. His story becomes the basis of several popular movies.

programs.title: History's Greatest Mysteries

programs.desc: The search for the most famous gold mine in the Old West has led many to perish in the pursuit of its elusive riches. Legend suggests the gold and the land it's hidden on are somehow cursed.

programs.title: Peacekeepers
programs.desc: This series goes to the heart of the Chinese army as they deploy to a UN peacekeeping mission in South Sudan. Filmed by the soldiers themselves, a 700-strong infantry battalion adapts to life on the base.

programs.title: The Mega-Brands That Built The World

programs.title: The Pickers
